If you're feeling stiff from sitting too long or just want a gentle way to get your body moving, this 10 minute gentle exercise routine is a great place to start. Designed for seniors, beginners, and desk workers, this low-impact workout helps improve mobility, reduce stiffness, increase circulation, and leave you feeling more energized—all from the comfort of home.
In this workout you'll:
• Improve mobility and flexibility
• Reduce stiffness and muscle tension
• Increase circulation and energy
• Support balance and everyday movement
• Enjoy a safe, low-impact exercise routine
